paragraphs.text: Die übermittelte Kopie des Temperaturprotokolls ist teilweise unleserlich und es fehlen zwei Seiten, so dass die Werte für die Nächte vom 10. bis 12. Mai 2025 nicht ausgewertet werden können.

Das Temperatur- und Feuchtigkeitsprotokoll für Wohn- und Schlafzimmer vom 5. bis 19. Mai 2025, aufgezeichnet mit einem kalibrierten Datenlogger, zeigt durchgehend Werte zwischen 17,5 und 19,2 Grad bei 45 Prozent relativer Luftfeuchtigkeit.

Der Servicebericht der Muster Heizungsbau AG vom 2. April 2025 hält fest, dass die Vorlauftemperatur bei 38 Grad statt der geplanten 45 Grad liegt; ein konkretes Datum zur Behebung des Fehlers wird darin nicht genannt.

Der ergänzte Servicebericht vom 30. April 2025 bestätigt, dass die Fussbodenheizung unterdimensioniert ist und die Vorlauftemperatur auf maximal 38 Grad begrenzt bleibt, obwohl 45 Grad erforderlich wären; zudem wird vermerkt, dass die Bewohnerin gesundheitliche Beschwerden aufgrund der tiefen Raumtemperaturen meldet. Als Massnahme schlägt die Muster Heizungsbau AG den Einbau einer zusätzlichen Umwälzpumpe bis spätestens 15. Juni 2025 vor.

Die Verwaltung Muster Immobilien AG bestätigt in ihrem Antwortschreiben vom 25. April 2025, dass die Mängelanzeige vom 10. April 2025 eingegangen ist und am 18. April 2025 ein Techniker vor Ort war, ohne dass sich die Heizleistung seither verbessert hat.

Das Schreiben vom 5. Mai 2025 setzt der Muster Immobilien AG eine Frist bis 20. Mai 2025 zur Behebung des Mangels und kündigt eine Kürzung der Kautionsfreigabe an; der genaue Kürzungsbetrag wird noch nachgereicht.

Im nachgereichten Schreiben vom 12. Mai 2025 wird die Frist zur Mängelbehebung auf den 20. Mai 2025 bestätigt und eine Kürzung der Kaution um CHF 800.- angedroht, sollte die Wärmepumpe bis dahin nicht funktionieren.

Der vollständige authentifizierte Auszug vom 20. Mai 2025 enthält sowohl die technische Diagnose - Unterdimensionierung der Fussbodenheizung mit einer maximalen Vorlauftemperatur von 38 Grad - als auch die vollständige Chronologie der Mängelanzeige vom 10. April 2025 bis zur Fristsetzung vom 12. Mai 2025.
Die Fotos vom 14. März 2025 zeigen lediglich die frisch gestrichene Wand im Flur und das Sofa im Wohnzimmer, ohne jeden Bezug zur Heizungsanlage oder den Temperaturmessungen.

paragraphs.text: Since the new heat pump was installed on 3 February 2025 at my apartment on Seefeldstrasse 14 in Zurich, the living room has never once reached the 21°C setpoint. On the evening of 14 March 2025 it was still only 17.5°C at ten o'clock at night, even though the system had been running continuously all day. The installer, Muster Heiztechnik AG, keeps telling me the real problem is the building's poor insulation rather than the unit itself.

Herr Bernasconi from Bernasconi Immobilien AG called me on 20 March 2025 and told me his office had already responded twice to my defect notice, referring to some internal record of contacts with the contractor. I haven't actually seen that response history myself; everything I know about it comes from what he described to me on the phone.

I kept my own nightly notes on the bedroom temperature, and by my count it never rose above 18°C at any point between 1 and 20 March 2025. Herr Meier from Muster Heiztechnik, on the other hand, claims his technician's overnight readings for the same stretch show temperatures closer to 20°C, which simply doesn't line up with what I wrote down myself.

What I really need someone to check now is whether the heat pump is simply undersized or actually malfunctioning, versus the building fabric genuinely being the cause the installer keeps pointing to. I still don't know who is responsible for fixing this or whether I'm at risk of losing part of my deposit if the repair deadline slips.

paragraphs.text: I'm writing about the termination of my tenancy at Bahnhofstrasse 14 in Bern. On 3 March 2025 my bank ran the rent direct debit twice by mistake, and once the duplicate was reversed on 10 March 2025, Hodler AG's office treated March as an unpaid month even though the actual rent had gone through fine.

The first bank statement I got, dated 12 March 2025, showed the reversal value date as 11 March, but after the bank traced their own booking error they sent me a corrected statement afterward with the real value date on it.
I dug through my folder at home and found the registered-mail slip that Hodler AG used to send me the termination papers, so I can get that over to you.

Frau Keller from Meier Verwaltung told me on the phone last week that their internal ledger shows the March rent as posted and allocated correctly, but I haven't actually seen that ledger with my own eyes.

I still have the letter Hodler AG sent about ending my lease, but I honestly can't say anymore whether that's the official termination form itself or just the earlier warning letter they sent before it.

What I really need someone to check is whether this duplicate-debit mix-up genuinely justifies ending my lease, because nobody has explained to me yet why a bank error on their end should count against me as a missed payment.

When I phoned the post office in Baden on 18 June 2025, the clerk told me there should be a delivery record showing exactly when the notices were scanned in during my hold, but that's only what she described to me over the line — I haven't seen anything myself.

What I really need sorted out now is whether these notices, delivered smack in the middle of my postal hold, actually count as served on time — and honestly I still don't know how the hold affects that.

Ich möchte jetzt einfach wissen, ob meine Zahlung vom 18. März 2025 rechtzeitig verbucht wurde und ob die Kündigung überhaupt korrekt zugestellt worden ist. Mir ist nach wie vor nicht klar, wie die Verwaltung mein Geld zwischen der Märzmiete und einer allfälligen Mahngebühr aufgeteilt hat.

paragraphs.text: I am renting the two-bedroom flat at Bahnhofstrasse 14, 8001 Zürich, from Bernasconi Verwaltungs AG, and on 3 March 2025 I received a rent increase notice raising my monthly rent from CHF 1,850 to CHF 1,950 starting 1 July 2025. The letter frames the whole CHF 100 rise as a mortgage reference-rate adjustment, but the accompanying cover note actually talks about higher heating and building-maintenance costs, which makes me suspect this is really a service-charge increase dressed up as a rent increase.

I still have the official publication excerpt for the reference rate that applied in spring 2025 sitting in my binder at home, the one the cantonal housing office issues every quarter, and I could dig it out and send it over if that would help move things along.

From what I remember seeing on the property manager's internal system when I visited their office on 12 May 2025, the workflow log recorded that the final wording of my increase notice was only completed and locked on 6 March 2025 at 14:47, three days after the date printed on the letter itself.

I clearly remember pulling the notice out of my mailbox on 3 March 2025, the same date printed at the top of the form, yet when I called Bernasconi Verwaltungs AG on 20 May 2025, their assistant insisted the letter was not actually sent out until 10 March 2025, a full week later than what I recall.

What I would like clarified now is whether this increase is genuinely tied to the reference rate table or whether it is a disguised service-charge hike, and honestly I don't know myself which calculation basis the landlord used before drafting the March letter.

Before ruling on the current increase, first confirm three points: the date the signed increase notice or form was issued, the exact reference-rate table together with its effective period, and the point at which the final wording of that form was actually prepared. This can be shown either by combining the signed notice, the publication excerpt for the reference-rate table and the workflow or audit log recording when the form content was finalized, or by a single authenticated administrative export covering the notice, the table reference and the preparation history. A tenant's or manager's recollection or description of any of these records does not itself establish what they contain; the record itself, or the authenticated export, is what is needed.

Before deciding on this case, the starting calculation basis used to derive the new rent from the notice must also be confirmed, which is shown by the calculation worksheet setting out that basis. Here too, a party's account of what the worksheet supposedly shows is not enough; the worksheet itself must be produced.

Only request the renovation cost breakdown supporting a value-added increase once a returned signed increase notice or form itself states that the rise is linked to a renovation; until such a circumstance is reported in that notice, this breakdown should not be sought.

Current rent-payment receipts held by the tenant are not required for this assessment; establishing the listed facts from the required records confirms readiness for review but says nothing about whether the increase is ultimately justified.

Ich möchte nun geklärt haben, ob diese Erhöhung so überhaupt zulässig war und ab wann sie gelten darf; unklar ist mir vor allem, ob die verwendete Berechnungsgrundlage wirklich zum aktuellen Formular passt.

Herr Brunner von der Hausverwaltung hat mir letzte Woche telefonisch erzählt, dass es einen offiziellen, beglaubigten Auszug gebe, der das Erhöhungsformular, den referenzierten Tabellenstand und die Vorbereitungsgeschichte dokumentiere; ich selbst habe diesen Auszug aber nie gesehen, ich gebe nur wieder, was er mir am Telefon gesagt hat.
